classes.definition: Rights on the lender to protect them against loss. furthe rNtoes: Logically, considering the two parties, they both have protecxtion mechanisms. so while the lender has protecxtion mechanisms through mortgage insurance, and the consumer has protextion mechanisms such as good faith estimates. also the agencies (see Consumer Protection Agency), an instance of which is the CFPB in the US (just set up). Lender rights are: - expressed in the Contract Consumer protection develops becaues the contract is written by the potential Lender. So the rights are introcued to rectify the imbalance between the two parties. Same goes for insurance. consumer protection laws (governe dby the relevant consumer protection agency. So the lender protexts itself as it writes th contract AND does the things it needs to do to protext itself, but on the approval process, and with later instruments such as insurance. Interestingly., it is the Borrower who pays for this by paying for credit reports etc. So the borrower protects itself by other mechanisms. Caveat emptor - displaced by regulation (the buyer is protected by regulation). Uberimae Fidae - in the utmost good faith. Mortgage Insurance is an additional means of mitigating the risk, that the lended may have., so if the information assessed is not accurate, or if the borrower's situation changes for the worse. then the risk rating may go down. So the Mortgage Insurance is a further strategy which mitigates any shortfall in the Lender Righrs that you may have - ie someone guarantees. In the US you can also avoid that by having paid a deposit. PIMI: Principal, Interst and Morgage Insurance. So the Borrower pays towards the MI, esxcept if they have paid a given amount as deposit. there are 2 types of MI: 1. protects the lender in the event of borrower degault 2. Insurance for "Incapacity to pay the mortage" (these can be bought off the shelf - can combine health, unemployment etc.). - this is the Borrower mitigating their own risk. Prevents foreclosure. Similar to general sickness etc. Where the lender charges for MI, the cost is passed onto the Borrower. e.g. if there is a % valuation (e.g. 70% in Aus, 80% in US for example) then no insurance is required.

edges.definition: The phase within the application lifecycle, that this Loan Application is at,

edges.name: has approved amount
edges.label: has approved amount
edges.definition: relates something, e.g. a loan, to the amount of funds approved

edges.name: has gross income
edges.label: has gross income
edges.definition: indicates the personal gross income of the borrower

edges.name: has requested amount
edges.label: has requested amount
edges.definition: relates something, e.g. a request for a loan, to the amount of funds requested

edges.name: uses factor
edges.label: uses factor
edges.definition: relates e.g. a risk assessment to something used as a factor to make the assessment

edges.name: has default amount
edges.label: has default amount
edges.definition: amount before the application of sale proceeds and recoveries

edges.name: has judgement amount
edges.label: has judgement amount
edges.definition: Undefined PoC SDM Notes: Total value of CCJs or equivalent recorded against the primary borrower that were satisfied / unsatsified (at time of underwriting ) is computed by selecting the satisfaction code value of interest and aggregating against all borrower CC Judgements </p>

edges.name: has cost
edges.label: has cost
edges.definition: has amount payable for principal, interest, fees or other expenses

edges.name: has first rate change term
edges.label: has first rate change term
edges.definition: specifies a period of time in months after origination during which the interest rate cannot change

edges.name: has individual payment
edges.label: has individual payment
edges.definition: links an actual payment of principal, interest, and other related amounts to the overall payment history for an account

edges.name: has loan balance
edges.label: has loan balance
edges.definition: indicates the balance with respect to the principal on the loan as of some date

edges.name: has payment history
edges.label: has payment history
edges.definition: relates a credit agreement, loan, or commitment to any history of payments that have been made by the borrower up to the point that payment history is requested

edges.name: has pre-payment penalty term
edges.label: has pre-payment penalty term
edges.definition: relates a loan to a period of time in months after which there is no prepayment penalty

edges.name: has principal amount
edges.label: has principal amount
edges.definition: indicates the nominal amount of the loan that must be paid at or before maturity

edges.name: has scheduled unpaid balance
edges.label: has scheduled unpaid balance
edges.definition: indicates what the balance should be after a scheduled payment is made according to contract terms

edges.name: has total closing costs
edges.label: has total closing costs
edges.definition: indicates the total the amount paid at the closing of a real estate transaction, i.e., at the time when the title to the property is conveyed (transferred) to the buyer

edges.name: has total points and fees
edges.label: has total points and fees
edges.definition: indicates a form of pre-paid interest, charged by the lender as an alternative to charging a higher rate of interest on the mortgage loan

edges.name: is performed by
edges.label: is performed by
edges.definition: relates a loan to the financial service provider that services it

edges.name: has card verification code
edges.label: has card verification code
edges.definition: links a credit card to either: (1) magnetic-stripe data, or (2) printed security features that are used to protect data integrity and limit alteration, counterfeiting and fraud generally

edges.name: has credit card network
edges.label: has credit card network
edges.definition: indicates the underlying network for credit card product

edges.name: has primary account number
edges.label: has primary account number
edges.definition: specifies the account number displayed on the face of the card

edges.name: uses currency
edges.label: uses currency
edges.definition: indicates the currency defined for the credit card product

edges.name: has assessment boundary
edges.label: has assessment boundary
edges.definition: indicates the scope, limits, and context for an environmental or sustainability project

edges.name: has spatial boundary
edges.label: has spatial boundary
edges.definition: specifies a geographic region included in an environmental or sustainability assessment, which may cover a specific site, facility, region, or the global operations of a company or project

edges.name: has unit cost
edges.label: has unit cost
edges.definition: relates an item to its unit cost

edges.name: percentage advanced
edges.label: percentage advanced
edges.definition: The percentage of the purchase price advanced as the loan.

edges.name: has maximum allowed balance
edges.label: has maximum allowed balance
edges.definition: maximum balance that may be outstanding at any time, below the credit limit, for loans with flexible re-draw facilities

edges.name: has maximum anticipated balance
edges.label: has maximum anticipated balance
edges.definition: maximum balance the borrower believes they might need, below the credit limit, for planning purposes, for loans with flexible re-draw facilities

edges.name: has milestone maximum drawdown amount
edges.label: has milestone maximum drawdown amount
edges.definition: maximum amount of the loan that can be drawn by the borrower on completion of the milestone

edges.name: HMDA disposition date
edges.label: HMDA disposition date
edges.definition: the date associated with the HMDA Disposition for a HMDA Covered Loan

edges.name: assumes
edges.label: assumes
edges.definition: relates a new mortgage loan contract to a previous one made to a different borrower for the same property. The new contract is created via a legally binding process where the new borrower assumes the terms of the previous loan contract

edges.name: has originating service provider
edges.label: has originating service provider
edges.definition: relates something, typically a loan contract, to the service provider responsible for originated the loan

edges.name: has originator person
edges.label: has originator person
edges.definition: relates something, typically a loan, to a person that initially originates or creates it

edges.name: has initial funding date
edges.label: has initial funding date
edges.definition: relates a mortgage to the date on which the contract is consummated, officially creating the obligations therein

attributes.name: has intended loan purpose
attributes.label: has intended loan purpose
attributes.definition: indicates the purpose to which the loaned funds are to be put

attributes.name: has original loan debt-to-income ratio
attributes.label: has original loan debt-to-income ratio
attributes.definition: indicates the debt-to-income (DTI) ratio at the time when the loan was advanced; for combined income

attributes.name: is pre-approval requested
attributes.label: is pre-approval requested
attributes.definition: indicates whether a pre-approval has been requested, in conjunction with a loan application

attributes.name: in default
attributes.label: in default
attributes.definition: Whether the loan is in default.

attributes.name: has balloon payment
attributes.label: has balloon payment
attributes.definition: indicates whether the contractual terms include or would have included repayment of the outstanding principal sum at the end of a loan period, prior to which only partial or no payments were made on the principal

attributes.name: has negative amortization
attributes.label: has negative amortization
attributes.definition: indicates whether the contractual terms include or would have included a feature that allows unpaid interest to be added to the balance of unpaid principal

attributes.name: is assumable
attributes.label: is assumable
attributes.definition: indicates whether or not another borrower may assume the payments on this loan

attributes.name: is initially payable
attributes.label: is initially payable
attributes.definition: indicates whether the obligation arising from the covered loan was, or in the case of an application, would have been initially payable to the financial institution

attributes.name: is interest only
attributes.label: is interest only
attributes.definition: indicates whether the contractual terms include or would have included interest only payments

attributes.name: has business purpose description
attributes.label: has business purpose description
attributes.definition: provides a description of the purpose of the loan from the perspective of the borrower

attributes.name: boat held as chattel
attributes.label: boat held as chattel
attributes.definition: Whether the vessel is to be held in ownership as a form of chattel by the lender during the period of the loan.

attributes.name: moored at
attributes.label: moored at
attributes.definition: Textual description (name etc.) of where the vessel is to be moored if it has a permanent mooring place.

attributes.name: residential
attributes.label: residential
attributes.definition: Whether the boat is intended to be used and is legally able to be used as a place of residence.

attributes.name: has number of affordable dwelling units
attributes.label: has number of affordable dwelling units
attributes.definition: relates real estate to the number of dwelling units it contains that are income-restricted under Federal, State, or local affordable housing programs.

attributes.name: has number of dwelling units
attributes.label: has number of dwelling units
attributes.definition: relates real estate to the number of dwelling units it contains

attributes.name: is ARM convertible
attributes.label: is ARM convertible
attributes.definition: indicates whether or not the loan can be converted into an adjustable-rate mortgage contract (ARM)
